title: Slat Piccolo Duct — Leak and Flow Check After Valve or Duct Disturbance
abstract: Leak and flow check of the slat piccolo duct run after a shut-off valve or duct joint has been disturbed, with the acceptance pressures and the thermal survey that confirms even distribution along the slat.

sections.purpose: This task gives the leak and flow check of the slat piccolo duct run, to be done after any disturbance of a wing anti-ice shut-off valve or of a duct joint, and the thermal survey that confirms the distribution along the slat.
sections.job_setup_note: The check is done with the aircraft on the ground, the slats retracted and the engines shut down, using a pneumatic ground cart set to the duct working pressure. The thermal survey needs an infrared camera and a clear view of the slat leading edge, so it cannot be done in direct sunlight or in rain. A soap solution leak check is not permitted on the piccolo holes; the holes are sized and any residue changes the flow.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the slats are retracted and that the flight deck anti-ice selector is off. 2. Connect the pneumatic ground cart at the wing root connection. WARNING: DO NOT STAND FORWARD OF THE SLAT LEADING EDGE WHEN THE DUCT IS PRESSURISED. THE PICCOLO HOLES DISCHARGE HOT AIR AT HIGH VELOCITY. 3. Raise the duct pressure slowly to the check pressure given in the figure and hold it. 4. Do a leak check at every duct joint using the ultrasonic leak detector. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SOAP SOLUTION ON THE PICCOLO HOLES. RESIDUE CHANGES THE HOLE FLOW AND CANNOT BE REMOVED IN SERVICE. 5. Record any joint that shows a leak indication and reject the check. 6. Command the shut-off valve open and record the time to full flow. 7. Hold the flow for the survey period given in the figure. 8. Do the thermal survey along the slat leading edge with the infrared camera and record the temperature at each station. 9. Confirm that no station is more than 15 degrees below the mean. 10. Command the valve closed and confirm that the flow stops within the closing time. 11. Reduce the duct pressure slowly and disconnect the ground cart.
sections.close_out: Disconnect the pneumatic ground cart and refit the wing root connection cap. Confirm that the slat leading edge is clear of tools and equipment. Record the leak check result, the time to full flow and the thermal survey readings in the aircraft maintenance record, and attach the survey image.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft post MOD-149880 the drain at the duct low point must be confirmed clear before step 3.

safety_precautions: Do not stand forward of the slat leading edge when the duct is pressurised.
Confirm that the slats are retracted before you start.
Wear hearing protection near the wing root connection.
